title: Palak Paneer
description: A popular Indian dish made with spinach and paneer cheese. This recipe is creamy, flavorful and pairs well with naan or rice.

ingredients.name: paneer
ingredients.notes: Indian cheese, cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin powder and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the garlic and ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the spinach leaves and sauté until wilted.
Add the coriander powder, nutmeg powder and salt. Mix well.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the paneer cubes and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee.
Serve hot with naan or rice.
